title: Give ownership
text: {{name}} will become the owner of “{{title}}”. They will be able to change its settings, archive it and manage the guests.
warnOrg: You will no longer be the owner: you will not be able to change the settings or archive the occasion, and you will manage the guests only if you administer the organization.
warn: You will no longer be the owner and will not be able to manage this occasion. Only this person will be able to give it back to you.
